items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: He was in a P. Rome's band.

ctx.x: He's a nice fella. Oh, we might ask this for a minute, I know Paul would be one of your favorite drummers and you mentioned a few others that you've worked with too. Are there any other drummers that you liked when you were a kid and young coming up that impressed you, especially some of the old timers, you know, I mean, maybe... Well, yeah. Did you ever hear old man Cottrell? No, no, no, no.
He was in a P. Rome's band.

No, no, I don't remember that. But I'll tell you a fella I used to like, Joe Relic. Oh, yeah. But this is what I want to tell you before I go. This is one thing I remember my daddy told me too, and I do that.
